messages:
dan (eng-releases): starting geo rollout dry-run. sequence: US -> EU (pinned) -> APAC. canary 10%, hold 20m. deploy-bot: initiating canary slice=canary-10 in us-central-1.
deploy-bot: preflight: warmpool attach, kv-prefetch, quant-profile=v3.2.
priya (oncall): quick capacity ask 1: spare GPUs in us pool? sustained token throughput headroom?
tom (eng-infra): us-central spare: 5 gpus (approx 150k TUs/hr). headroom ~35% vs baseline QPS. APAC pool currently lower headroom (~8%) due to background backfills.
sarah (sre): note: thermals in apac-east racks trending up (avg 78C), recommend lowering burst cap for APAC warmup.
dan (eng-releases): acknowledge. we'll proceed with US hold; pause EU->APAC auto if thermal >75C.
nana (product): typo; that's ana.
nana (product): thanks :) Any EU pin details? legal asked to keep EU clients on v2.3.8 for schema support.
matt (ml): v2.3.8 is fine. v3 models differ in tokenization edgecases. Recommend explicit fallback policy to avoid auto-upgrade.
dan (eng-releases): decision: pin eu-west-1 to v2.3.8 for this wave. deploy-bot: `pin --region eu-west-1 --version v2.3.8 --reason "schema/legal"`
deploy-bot: pin applied.
zoe (support): I'll update release notes: "EU pinned to v2.3.8 (schema compatibility). See upgrade guide."
priya (oncall): define rollback triggers? propose: p95 latency >220ms for 2 consecutive 10m OR 5xx rate >1% for 5m. Also OOM or thermal >82C immediate.
sarah (sre): updated triggers: p95>200ms for 10m or 5xx>0.7% affecting >2% users OR rack temp>80C. Rollback action: pin previous version + route to dedicated-fallback pool.
dan (eng-releases): capture that in runbook. deploy-bot: run smoke tests (50 reqs).
deploy-bot: smoke: 48/50 ok, p95=130ms, median=70ms, kv-hit=87%.
matt (ml): quality quick-check: golden-set pass 92%. minor tokenization diffs flagged (non-blocking).
tom (eng-infra): enabling short-circuit fallback for us: `deployctl set-fallback --region us --target dedicated-fallback --thresholds p95:200ms:10m,5xx:0.8%`
deploy-bot: fallback policy active for us-central-1.
dan (eng-releases): US holdpoint 20m. if stable, we'll open EU canary (pinned v2.3.8) at 10%. APAC warmup scheduled +90m but will be delayed if thermal doesn't cool.
priya (oncall): I'll monitor heatmap and autoscaler. tagging oncall: @priya.
zoe (support): prewriting customer messages for APAC customers; will include rollback instructions and status link.
nana (product): release notes draft attached below in doc, calling out EU pin and APAC delayed warmup.
sarah (sre): during hold, I saw a minor spike in tail latency for internal batch jobs (not user-facing) at t+7m. not triggered. keep watch.
priya (oncall): at t+12m p95 steady ~135ms, no 5xx. APAC rack temps slowly cooling to 72C.
dan (eng-releases): good. proceed to open EU canary to 10% (still pinned). deploy-bot: rolling canary to eu-west-1 (slice=canary-10).
deploy-bot: warmup + smoke in EU: 50 reqs -> 50/50 ok, p95=160ms, median=90ms.
matt (ml): EU quality quick-check pass 95%.
zoe (support): updating status page: "EU canary live (pinned). APAC warmup pending thermal check."
priya (oncall): APAC pool headroom now ~12% after background drains finish. still want extra margin before warmup.
dan (eng-releases): decision: delay APAC warmup by 30m and set APAC thermostat conservative for 30m. tom: command?
tom (eng-infra): `deployctl set-thermostat apac-east --mode conservative --duration 30m`
deploy-bot: thermostat applied.
priya (oncall): one more check: token-cost delta for canary in US ~+2.3% (expected).
matt (ml): that's within acceptable range.
dan (eng-releases): final: will not auto-fallback EU to newer versions; APAC warmup delayed pending temps. rollback triggers and commands recorded in runbook. If anything trips, immediate `deploybot rollback --region <region> --to-version <prev>` + `deploybot route --region <region> --to dedicated-fallback`.
deploy-bot: us-central canary status healthy. eu-west-1 canary status healthy (pinned). rollout paused at holdpoints.
